groups.name: infrastructure
groups.why: the stack, the gates and the pipeline themselves: whatever runs the checks has changed, so every check runs. The nginx.conf of the SPA is here because scripts/deployment/check-nginx-configuration.sh, a step of compose-topology, parses it

groups.name: client-read-by-server
groups.why: client files that .NET tests outside DM.Architecture.Tests read as data: EmailThemeShould the styles, the markup tests the grammar, hint, corpus, alphabet and round-trip tables. Ahead of client, which would otherwise claim them without the build job

groups.name: client
groups.why: the SPA, its configs and its end-to-end suite; ahead of server, which would otherwise claim it through src/**

groups.name: server
groups.why: the solution and what it builds from; API_DESIGN.md sits here because OpenApiContractShould, an integration test of the build job, reads it

groups.name: docs
groups.why: prose and agent configuration; read by DM.Architecture.Tests and by client unit specs that resolve file names and quote documents

full.why: a path no group names is a path nobody has decided about, so it runs everything rather than nothing

build.why: format, Release build, every .NET test and the coverage threshold

frontend.why: client specs read the server tree: artifacts/openapi-*.json, controllers, every file a comment names

e2e.why: the suite drives both halves through a browser

deployment-smoke.why: builds the API and the SPA images and serves them through the edge

dependency-scan.why: the packages of both halves; advisories that appear without a change are the nightly run's

zap-scan.why: scans the API on its own port, the SPA is not in its target

compose-topology.why: reads docker/, scripts/ and the nginx.conf of the SPA, all of them infrastructure, so it runs on a full run alone

docs.why: DM.Architecture.Tests and the client unit specs; the build job runs the former anyway and the frontend job the latter
